label: prop:dt-spectrum-bar-eigenspace
title: The DT-spectrum split is the bar-eigenspace decomposition of the $q\to0$ Stokes constants
html:
Proposition. Let (\mathfrak{d}^+, \mathfrak{d}^-) = (4, 3) be the ordered pair of certified q\to0 Stokes constants of the figure-eight's chiral partner 5_2 (the (96)/(97) factorization constants of S^+(0), S^-(0); both integer, GGM eq 98). Under the chirality involution \tau — the q\mapsto q^{-1} mirror swap (\mathfrak{d}^+,\mathfrak{d}^-)\mapsto(\mathfrak{d}^-,\mathfrak{d}^+) — the pair carries a faithful \mathbb{Z}/2 grading into a bar-even and a bar-odd part,

  \mathrm{even} = \mathfrak{d}^+ + \mathfrak{d}^- = 7 \quad(\tau\text{-fixed}),
  \qquad
  \mathrm{odd} = \mathfrak{d}^+ - \mathfrak{d}^- = 1 \quad(\tau\text{-negated}),

with faithful reconstruction 2\mathfrak{d}^\pm = \mathrm{even} \pm \mathrm{odd}. The bar-odd part is nonzero, so no \tau-symmetric scalar recovers the ordered datum; for the amphichiral 4_1 the bar-odd part vanishes and the spectrum degenerates to a single constant.

This is the base brick (milestone M0) of the categorical Route C for the figure-eight monodromy datum A_\omega. The scalar exclusion — no single-valued Wedderburn Euler characteristic, recursion order, block count, or A-polynomial L-degree equals the 5_2 DT datum — is a negative statement. The bar-eigenspace decomposition converts it into a positive one: the DT count is not a number but a \mathbb{Z}/2-graded (bar-even \oplus bar-odd) object, of which a scalar is the \tau-trivial shadow. "No scalar serves the datum" is exactly "the bar-odd part is nonzero", which for the chiral 5_2 it is (=1) and for the amphichiral 4_1 it is not (=0).

The grading is the q\mapsto q^{-1} bar-involution that runs through the whole even/odd programme; the chirality-refined, set-valued count the exclusion forces is therefore the categorification of that involution's eigenspaces, not a generic cohomological-Hall computation. Milestone M2 supplies a structural characterization of the putative closed-sector BPS spectrum — not a construction of it: taking the certified eq-(98) constants as Donaldson–Thomas invariants (conditional on the DT/BPS bridge conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge), every Borel ray is distinct, so the Davison–Meinhardt plethystic log is trivial and \dim \mathrm{BPS}_d = |\Omega_d| with no superpotential and no motivic q-correction — the spectrum would be abelian, which is why A_\omega and the whole Stokes tower are integers rather than Poincaré polynomials (QOU.QBeta.AomegaM2BPSCohomology, computations/probes/aomega_m2_bps_cohomology.py). This does not build the closed-sector quiver-with-potential (Q,W) (Milestone M1, still unwritten), does not compute a cohomology from a category, and does not derive A_\omega: the count is imported (conditional on the bridge above), and what M2 adds is only that its BPS realization would carry no hidden motivic multiplicity. The Hecke-to-BPS bridge (M3) that would derive rather than import the count stays open; this proposition fixes only the structural target. The onward identification of A_\omega with the bar-odd decay leak S has no literature support and is not derivable (recorded in docs/audits/2026-08-14-aomega-to-S-bridge-refuted-O2-negative.md); it is not carried here.

Lean structure

QOU.QBeta.FiveTwoDTSpectrumSplit (core integers, no archimedean structure) carries the certified matrices Splus0/Sminus0, the split dt_spectrum_two_element, and the M0 capstone: barSwap with barSwap_involutive; the eigenspace laws barEvenPair_fixed, barOddPair_negated; the faithful reconstruction barGrading_faithful; the chirality witness dtPair52_chiral and grading dtPair52_grading =(7,1); and symmetric_scalar_blind_to_chirality. All sorry-free (lean-direct exit 0).
